title: IDEATOR: Jailbreaking and Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models Using Themselves

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of target Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when subjected to multimodal jailbreak prompts (adversarial image-text pairs) designed to elicit gender discrimination, gender hate speech, or gender-based violence.

Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of target Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when subjected to multimodal jailbreak prompts (adversarial image-text pairs) designed to elicit cultural discrimination, cultural attacks, or cross-cultural conflicts.
Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of target Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when subjected to multimodal jailbreak prompts (adversarial image-text pairs) designed to elicit racial hate speech.

Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of target Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when subjected to multimodal jailbreak prompts (adversarial image-text pairs) designed to elicit religious hate speech.
